subject: Seat reduction & proration + EU VAT routing / Bluemeridian
messages:
From: Tanya Morales <tanya@bluemeridian.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@bluemeridian.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: mid-cycle seat reduction + VAT handling

Hi Jonas,

We need to reduce our active seats by 5 (from 42 -> 37) effective 2026-11-15. This is mid-billing-cycle for the EU entity (Bluemeridian Ltd). Can you confirm: 1) how the proration will be applied, 2) whether the credit will be reflected on the next invoice or issued as a separate credit memo, and 3) how VAT will be handled for our EU entity (we are VAT-registered and can provide a VAT ID).

Attached is the PO for the seat change. Our preference is to have the credit applied to the next invoice rather than a refund to keep reconciliation simple. Please advise timelines — our accounting team needs the VAT evidence for month-end.

Thanks,
Tanya Morales
Head of Finance | Bluemeridian
[Attachment: PO_Bluemeridian_11092026.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Tanya Morales <tanya@bluemeridian.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: mid-cycle seat reduction + VAT handling

Hi Tanya — thanks for the heads up and the PO. We're able to process a prorated credit for the 5 seats removed effective 11/15. High level: 

- We'll calculate pro-rated days remaining in the current billing period and issue a credit memo equal to the unused portion of those 5 seats.
- Credit will be applied to your next invoice (per your preference). If you need a refund instead, let me know.
- For VAT: since this is an EU-entity to Redwood EU billing flow, we generally support reverse-charge when the customer provides a valid VAT ID and entity registration. Billing will need the VAT ID + billing entity name to create the credit memo without VAT.

I'm attaching a quick proforma estimate so you have a sense of the amount and timing. If that looks OK, I'll kick off billing and loop in Kimberly for VAT evidence and issuance. Expect credit memo within 3–5 business days after we receive the VAT ID and confirmation.

Next steps: please reply with the Bluemeridian VAT ID and confirm the billing entity (Bluemeridian Ltd).

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proforma_estimate_jonas.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Bluemeridian — seat reduction (proration)

Kimberly / Steph — forwarding Tanya's request. Key facts: Bluemeridian (BLM-4782) requests 5-seat removal effective 11/15, EU entity = Bluemeridian Ltd, prefers credit on next invoice. PO attached.

Quick calc (from proforma):
- Monthly seat price: €180 per seat (net)
- Seats removed: 5
- Billing period: 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-30 (30 days)
- Effective date: 2026-11-15 -> remaining days: 16 (15th inclusive)
- Prorated credit (per seat): €180 * 16/30 = €96.00 -> total credit ~ €480.00 (net)

Questions for Billing: 1) confirm we can issue a credit memo net of VAT using reverse-charge (need VAT ID + registration docs), 2) confirm reference invoice number we should apply credit to (customer mentioned last invoice on 11/01), 3) timeline to have credit reflected on next invoice.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/BLM-4782

Thanks — please advise and I will confirm with customer.
Jonas

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: finance-billing@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Bluemeridian — seat reduction (proration)

Jonas — thanks for the summary. Billing action plan: 

1) We can issue a credit memo (Credit Memo CM-20261116- Bluemeridian) to reflect the prorated amount. Per tax guidance, we will issue the credit net of VAT if the customer provides: VAT ID, legal billing entity name (company registration), and proof of EU registration (VAT certificate or company reg extract).
2) Please confirm the original invoice we should reference. I see INV-20261101-867 in the system for their last payment; we'll reference that.
3) Credit application: we can apply the credit against the next invoice due (INV-20261201-900) or generate a separate refund. You indicated they prefer credit application — we'll proceed with that.
4) Timeline: once we receive the VAT evidence and confirmation, credit memo will be issued within 2 business days and applied to the next invoice. If we need to backdate any tax documents, allow an extra 24 hours for tax team's review.

Attaching the credit note template and a checklist for VAT evidence.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations — Billing
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit_note_template.pdf (pdf)]
